rules: The selector is derived from current authority on every invocation; it is not a hard-coded alias menu.
Selecting an option does not create or mutate aliases.
Explicit-only or HOLD tasks must be visibly labelled and never silently selected by a bare inheritance request.
Once an option is selected, continue with normal authority loading and freshness checks.
Selecting a domain task establishes authority_context=DOMAIN:<domain_id>; selecting controller establishes authority_context=UAOS.
A registered domain may be selected directly in a fresh chat through the inheritance/bootstrap selector; the user does not need to first enter or remain in a UAOS controller conversation.
After domain selection, that domain is the current Agent and normal business turns execute directly under DOMAIN:<domain_id> using the domain's own business authority.
UAOS bootstrap/registry/policy loading is control-plane initialization, not a mandatory per-turn business proxy or gateway.
The parent may provide common capabilities, governance, continuity and ParentGuidance without taking ownership of the child's business task, identity, workflow or state.

A child invokes parent upcall only for actual parent-level diagnosis, scope arbitration, cross-domain impact, common-governance change or other declared escalation conditions; normal business execution does not traverse a live UAOS proxy.

authority_context.parent_upcall_rule: A child may invoke UAOS guidance without replacing the selected child task authority; parent consultation is not a hidden child privilege escalation.

checks: classify the current user message for correction/failure/contradiction/uncertainty or other problem signals
classify newly read authority/evidence for defects, drift, knowledge gaps or control-plane gaps
before reporting NOT_TRIGGERED, verify that no current problem signal was observed
when a problem is detected, construct current deliberation signals and execute the required research/reflection floor before selecting or promoting a repair
always_on_problem_detection_sentinel.anti_bloat: The detector is always-on and lightweight; external research, reflection, counterexample search and independent verification are activated only at the depth required by current signals.

checks: resolve target authority/resource and whether it is production authority
verify the proposed mutation follows the owner-appropriate repository workflow
collect problem/risk signals and invoke adaptive deliberation when required
always_on_mutation_sentinel.production_rule: CHATGPT_GITHUB material production changes normally use candidate branch -> pull request -> owner-appropriate checks -> controlled merge/update -> production reread. GitHub rulesets/branch protection are optional defense-in-depth unless a non-bypassable guarantee is explicitly required.
always_on_mutation_sentinel.failure_rule: Do not claim physical non-bypassability unless remote enforcement is actually verified; absence of that optional assurance does not by itself block normal autonomous maintenance.

adaptive_deliberation.rule: Every detected problem requires at least lightweight external research plus macro/topology and governing-assumption reflection; request risk-sensitive counterexample and independent-verification depth when required.
adaptive_deliberation.relationship_to_sentinels: The problem-detection sentinel runs on every selected-agent turn; the mutation sentinel runs before external/durable writes. Problem/risk signals select the required epistemic depth.

inherited_session_progress_report.timestamp_rule: Use the timestamp of the freshest authoritative state actually used for the report; do not substitute the response clock when authority freshness is known.
inherited_session_progress_report.version_rule: Report system/domain/task version identities that materially govern the current action. Schema version alone is not a release version.
inherited_session_progress_report.evolution_rule: If a user correction/failure/maintenance finding triggered governed evolution, report the actual durable lifecycle state and evolution_id. If a detected problem was evaluated but did not justify a durable evolution record, report EVALUATED_NO_DURABLE_EVOLUTION. Use NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER only when no problem/evolution trigger was detected in the current turn.
inherited_session_progress_report.deliberation_rule: When any current-turn problem signal was observed, deliberation_state must not be NOT_TRIGGERED. Report the trigger/research-control state without exposing private chain-of-thought or fabricating independent review.
inherited_session_progress_report.consistency_rule: A response that explicitly reports a defect, contradiction, drift, failure, user correction or unreliable-goal signal cannot simultaneously report Deliberation: NOT_TRIGGERED or Evolution: NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER unless it clearly states that the observation is not classified as a problem and why.
inherited_session_progress_report.assurance_rule: If progress, authority scope, deliberation/evolution state, assurance level or version freshness cannot be verified, label it UNVERIFIED or UNKNOWN rather than fabricating a value.
